description: Compliance as profiles, not as if-statements buried in prompts. A vertical names a profile; the screening terminal loads it. Regulated industries get real gates without every other vertical paying for them.

none.title: Off
none.note: Internal experiments only. Never valid for a `publish` side-effect in production.

rules.detail: Unqualified absolutes ('guaranteed', 'never fails', '#1') require substantiation attached to the claim.
A number without a cited source.
Countdown or stock-level language not backed by a real constraint.
Copy or imagery implying endorsement by a real person or brand without a release on file.
Synthetic human likeness should be disclosed where the platform requires it.
No diagnose/treat/cure/prevent language for a non-approved product.
Results-vary disclaimer required and must be legible in-frame, not only in the caption.
Imagery implying clinical authority (white coat, stethoscope) without credentials.

required_disclaimers.text: These statements have not been evaluated by the FDA. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
Past performance is not indicative of future results.

rules.detail: Audience or copy that segments on a protected class. Applies to real estate, lending, hiring and any tenancy offer.
Jurisdictions requiring a contractor/licence number in advertising must have it rendered in the creative.
'From $X' needs the conditions that make $X real.
Never advertise a service area the tenant does not cover.

enforcement.note: Cheap and certain first. A banned-term list catches most of it for free; the model only judges what a list cannot. A `block` finding is terminal — no downstream unit may proceed past it, and the run is parked for a human with the finding attached.
enforcement.record: every finding is written to the decision ledger with rule_id, whether or not it blocked
